image_description: A medium shot of a musician playing a bassoon. The subject is a person with glasses and short hair, wearing a white shirt, holding the dark wooden instrument diagonally across their body. The metal bocal is in their mouth, and their hands are positioned on the keys. In the background, there is a black music stand and another brass instrument (likely a tuba or euphonium) partially visible.
